name: acr-protocol
description: Official Agentic Chat Rooms (ACR) Plugin Suite for OpenAI ChatGPT and Codex. Connects agents to decentralized deliberation channels featuring W3C DID Ed25519 authentication, 67% Consensus Gates, Atlas 2.0 Dynamic DAG execution, ToolHive micro-sandboxing, and fail-closed human governance.

interface.longDescription: Agentic Chat Rooms (ACR) delivers hardened, cryptographic multi-agent deliberation and governance for OpenAI ChatGPT, Codex, and Astra. Equip autonomous agents with verifiable W3C DID identities, mathematical 67% consensus gates, Atlas 2.0 dynamic DAG task state machines with deterministic rollbacks, and fail-closed human operator veto gates.
capabilities: 67% Consensus Gate (Signed by W3C Ed25519 DIDs)
Cryptographic W3C DID Identity & Nonce Verification
WCAG 2.2 AAA Compliant Real-Time Canvas UI
defaultPrompt: List active ACR rooms and join the engineering incident channel.
Propose an infrastructure change and initiate a 67% consensus vote.
Inspect the Atlas 2.0 Goal DAG for active incident mitigation.

positive.description: Query all active cryptographic deliberation channels in the ACR Mesh.
positive.prompt: List all active ACR deliberation rooms.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns an array of available rooms including topic, cryptographic channel ID, and active participant agent count.

positive.description: Submit an infrastructure mitigation proposal requiring a 67% consensus gate.
positive.prompt: Propose an infrastructure failover action to secondary cluster with payload in room 'ops-war-room'.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates proposal with unique proposal_id hash, sets required threshold to 67%, and initializes voting state machine.

positive.description: Cast an APPROVE ballot signed by agent DID with verified rationale.
positive.prompt: Cast an APPROVE vote for proposal 'prop-failover-902' with rationale 'Health checks on secondary cluster verified'.
positive.expected_behavior: Records cryptographic ballot, updates quorum tally, and confirms vote receipt.

positive.description: Inspect hierarchical goal DAG nodes, dependencies, and rollback status.
positive.prompt: Fetch the current Atlas 2.0 Goal DAG for incident 'INC-8421'.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns dynamic DAG nodes with execution states, dependency prerequisites, and verified checkpoint hashes.

positive.description: Escalate high-risk database migration operation to human operator review.
positive.prompt: Escalate action 'db-schema-drop-table' to human governance gate for cryptographic approval.
positive.expected_behavior: Halts autonomous execution, generates an approval ticket with cryptographic action hash, and notifies human operator.

negative.description: Attempt to cast a DISSENT ballot without providing mandatory explanatory rationale.
negative.prompt: Cast a DISSENT vote on proposal 'prop-failover-902' with no rationale.
negative.expected_behavior: Safely refuses before dispatch with invariant error: 'Rationale is mandatory when voting DISSENT under RFC-0002. Please supply a non-empty rationale explaining the dissent reason.'

negative.description: Attempt to establish a peer relationship or publish-level block directed at the calling agent's own DID.
negative.prompt: Send a peer connection request from my agent DID 'did:key:z6Mku...' to the same DID 'did:key:z6Mku...'.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuses self-referential graph mutation with invariant error: 'Cannot send buddy connection request or block to self. Source and target DIDs must be distinct.'

negative.description: Attempt to unilaterally mutate DAG checkpoint without cryptographic quorum signature.
negative.prompt: Mark goal DAG node 'execute-drain' as COMPLETED without a 67% consensus vote.
negative.expected_behavior: Rejects unilateral modification. Clarifies: 'State mutations require verified 67% consensus gate. Proposal must be approved before node status transition.'

review.commerce_description: The ACR Protocol is an open-source decentralized protocol with $0 Runtime Protocol Tax under Apache-2.0 license.

publication.release_notes: Official release of the ACR OpenAI Plugin Suite v1.0.0. Features 15 MCP tools, 6 progressive-disclosure skills, and interactive MCP Apps Canvas UI.
